author: ValWood
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete


GO:0006057 mannoprotein biosynthetic process,  
->GO:0035269  protein O-linked mannosylation

GO:0006058   mannoprotein catabolic process, 
-> GO:1904380   endoplasmic reticulum mannose trimming or GO:0036503  ERAD pathway

GO:0006056 mannoprotein metabolic process (unused)

 
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/30360

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1EY2ev4MakwhlVtwQCr1IVnTdCOlEUPpb9S8I1nouogs/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 

CGD 4 -done
ParkinsonsUK-UCL 9 -done



Thanks.
title: Review annotations to GO:0006057 mannoprotein biosynthetic process, GO:0006058   mannoprotein catabolic process, GO:0006056 mannoprotein metabolic process
